message:
We've all had those moments where we think we’re just a little too prepared. Like when we packed our go-bags last summer, and my partner joked about us being ready for a zombie apocalypse. Fast forward to this week, and we found ourselves in the middle of unexpected storms, with power outages and road closures everywhere. 

As we pulled out our ready-to-go bags, I couldn’t help but smirk a bit at the irony. It’s those little moments of readiness that can really make a difference, isn’t it? 🌧️ 

Have you had a moment like this? We’d love to hear your own tips or tricks for staying prepared!
